title: Minuet in G minor, BWV Anh. 115
subtitle: from the Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach (1725)
trains: The G major minuet’s companion in the minor: the same two-line minuet texture in 3/4, reading B flat and E flat from the key, F sharp as the leading note, and E natural and B natural as the music passes through B flat major and F major before returning home; mordents (bars 13, 22) and short trills (bars 8, 9, 15, 31). Both halves repeated.

provenance.credit: Typeset by Allen Garvin for the Mutopia Project (Mutopia-2015/08/21-76) from the Bach-Gesellschaft edition, and placed in the public domain by the typesetter.
provenance.note: Converted from Mutopia's LilyPond source to MusicXML by pnpm library:convert-ly (notes, rests, repeats and voltas, grace notes, clefs, slurs, dynamics); beams and accidentals then completed by pnpm library:engrave. Checked mechanically against the LilyPond source and Mutopia's own MIDI file (audit record). The Notebook copy is unsigned; it is attributed to Christian Petzold (1677-1733), as the source itself notes.
